verification: The census gate wrote and signed data/census.json before checking it, then would have raised (blocking the afterok fit array) if fewer than 10 classes qualified; it did not raise. 13 classes qualified in all 3 splits. The analyze stage's built-in guard refit the all-class support surface from exp-5's stored grid predictions and exp-6's full-feature ICC and compared its point b = gamma_e * ln2 against exp-6's own analysis.json:surfaces.full.b.point within 1e-6; the job did not raise, confirming the reimplemented surface refit reproduces exp-6 exactly on the unrestricted class set before it is applied to the site-class-restricted grid. No classifier used in the guard or the grid refit was retrained; both read exp-5's/exp-6's stored predictions and correlations only. The 45 new fits (3 allocations x 3 splits x 5 draws) trained fresh multinomial logistic models on the sampled site allocations.
run_summary: census: for each split, grouped eligible (>=32-patch) TCGA-UT patients by tissue-source-site code and kept classes whose site pool has >=10 sites in every split (13 of 30). fit: for each (split, allocation) shard and each of 5 draws, sampled the deep/broad5/broad10 site allocations (nested per Eq. nesting) plus shared fixed background classes, tuned and fit a multinomial logistic classifier, and wrote its run record. analyze: loaded the 45 new fits' and the reused 27 exp-5 grid fits' stored test predictions under the same paired Bayesian bootstrap context (2000 replicates, row 0 = unweighted observed) as exp-5/exp-6, restricted patient-macro recall to the 13 site classes, refit the support surface on the site-class grid (correlations fixed at their exp-6 full-feature point estimate) per bootstrap replicate, computed A_D/A_5/A_10, the site gain Delta_S = A_10 - A_5, the within-site residual b_W (Eq. within-site), and classified both against the +-1pp threshold.
reporting_notes: Site-class-restricted accuracy (%, patient-macro balanced, mean of 15 split-draw points): deep 58.50 [57.27, 59.68], broad5 69.41 [68.16, 70.63], broad10 70.25 [68.95, 71.49]; all-30-class accuracy alongside: deep 65.01, broad5 68.50, broad10 68.86.
Site gain Delta_S = 0.84pp, 95% CI [0.55, 1.14] -- crosses the 1pp threshold from below.
Within-site residual b_W = 1.79pp per doubling, 95% CI [1.22, 2.35] -- interval lies entirely above 1pp.
Reference residual b_ref (site classes, sites not controlled) = 0.79pp, 95% CI [0.19, 1.38]; b_W - b_ref = 1.01pp, 95% CI [0.70, 1.31], both intervals excluding zero.
Refitted site-class surface: beta_hat = 5.70 [4.92, 6.49] (log-Neff slope), gamma_hat = 1.14 [0.27, 1.99] (log-G slope); Neff(5,32) = 10.36, Neff(20,8) = 37.44 on the site-class subset.

Interpretation label: inconclusive. Delta_S crosses the 1pp threshold (does not sit entirely above it), so neither the site_coverage nor the both reading is established, even though b_W alone clears the threshold. Results prose and the stratified core/added/other breakdown are not yet written up in the report body.

checks: Local analysis.json, distributions.npz, and census.json SHA-256 match the live Hydra artifacts byte-for-byte.
live_verification.interval_rule: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of entries 1 onward; entry 0 is the observed (all-ones-weight) estimate
live_verification.dispersion_definition: Population SD over 15 split-draw accuracy points, restricted to site classes, including between-split variation
